blocking_gaps.finding: No persistent or documented fixture-server entry point exposes /form-controls for manual native execution. The only ownedPages registration for that path is inside form-control-owned-fixture.test.mjs; its server listens on an ephemeral port and closes when the test ends. The fixture report's route claim establishes test-time serving only. Supply a controlled runner/URL and record its actual URL and hash before any manual result cell is promoted.

Every inventory case still has a fixture-availability precondition saying no checked-in owned fixture exists and instructs the runner to provision one. This conflicts with the committed HTML and can cause a runner to stage a different page. Update the nine procedures to identify the exact committed fixture, serving command/URL, and checksum; retain the native verification gate.

A_fixture_and_procedure_faithfulness.native_limit: No native extension/browser run occurred. Event order, actual browser defaults, extension permissions, member/admin execution, and the absence of a network request are unverified.

findings.finding: The selector/event test reads the authored inventory and authored HTML, then checks IDs and event-name strings. It does not execute the fixture script or assert event-driven state changes. For example, deleting the listener registration while leaving the event-name array would keep the source checks green. A passing test therefore cannot validate the observable counters or defaults in a real DOM.

The HTTP test checks that served bytes hash to the same in-memory page value it passed to the server; this proves transport of those bytes, but does not independently validate the recorded SHA-256 or native route availability.

B_quality_and_test_validity.status_preservation: Source checks only; no inventory result cell or native acceptance coverage should be promoted.
